## Changes

Describe the user-visible change and link any related issue.

## Verification

- [ ] `jlpm lint:check` and `jlpm test:types` pass.
- [ ] The extension builds and its installed-wheel tests pass.
- [ ] Relevant Notebook and JupyterLab browser tests pass.
- [ ] Documentation and the changelog describe changed behavior.
- [ ] Screenshots cover visual changes, including a narrow viewport and both themes.

Do not attach confidential notebooks, credentials, or sensitive output.
